proposals.name: National Storm Hub — Storm Passport and Atlas
proposals.problem: US homeowners need accessible source-grounded storm information, property preparedness history and genuinely optional access to verified recovery services.
proposals.hypothesis: A ZIP-first free Passport and evidence-backed Atlas could improve returning use and support a distinct contractor intelligence product without unconsented lead sales.
proposals.experiment: Offline prototype; independently verify NWS alert freshness, event provenance, saved ZIP and consent separation; test with users before partner activation.
